title: Shoes, Then Coat
can_do: 用 first/then 提出并完成两个熟悉的准备步骤。
trigger: Shoes and a coat are both needed before leaving, and the child chooses the order.
core_response: First my shoes, then my coat.
stretch_response: First I will put on my shoes, then my coat.
repair_response: Shoes first, not the coat yet.
setting: Getting ready at the front door.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: We need your shoes and coat before we leave.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: First I put on my shoes, then my coat.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: One shoe is hiding behind the bag.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: I found it. Shoes first, then I can get my coat.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Both shoes are on. Your coat is by the door.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Now my coat is on. I am ready.

replay_cards.title: Wash and eat
replay_cards.change: Hands need washing and the snack needs carrying
replay_cards.challenge: Choose wash first, then carry the plate; complete both steps

replay_cards.title: Pajamas and teeth
replay_cards.challenge: Propose pajamas first and teeth second; complete the sequence with Mom

parent_support: Offer two necessary steps and accept either safe order.
Use first and then while acting, not as a memory quiz afterward.
